IC1: Written informed consent prior to beginning specific protocol procedures, including expected cooperation of the patients for the treatment and follow-up, willingness and ability to complete collection of data via wearable device and study mobile must be obtained and documented according to the local regulatory requirements.
IC4: Metastatic invasive hormone receptor positive and HER2 negative breast cancer (histologically confirmed).
IC5: Patients who in the opinion of the treating physician are candidates suitable for randomization for mono-chemotherapy treatment, that has either an approved label in Europe and/or is supported by guidelines for the treatment of first-line advanced BC, which are based on evidence on safety and efficacy in this setting.
IC6: Symptomatic [OR] or asymptomatic metastatic breast cancer.
IC7: Resolution of all acute toxic effects [AND] of prior anti-cancer therapy [OR] or surgical procedures to NCI CTCAE version 4.0 grade = 1 (except alopecia or other toxicities not considered a safety risk for the patient at investigator's discretion).
IC9: For female patients: The patients need to be either A) of non-childbearing potential (documented postmenopausal or post hysterectomy) B) childbearing potential with negative serum or urinary pregnancy test (in this case patients need to use highly effective non-hormonal contraceptive methods).
